analysis_role: post-hoc diagnostic on the already-scored 21-model development cohort
metric_definition: For each view, sum squared linear-gray render error only at pixels where the candidate and 2x-MSAA-resolved source binary coverage masks XOR; divide by total squared linear-gray error. Pool error energy across 24 frozen view-distance pairs within each asset, then average assets within each of the 16 source groups.
limitations: Same asset cohort was already inspected; this is not independent confirmation.
The XOR attribution mask is a diagnostic definition, not a perceptual metric.
Flat grayscale shading and fixed desktop views do not establish user preference or mobile behavior.

protocol.reference: full source at 2x resolution with 4x MSAA and linear box resolve
